nom: Paula's Choice Defense Essential Glow Moisturiser Spf 30

avis.texte: This is a FANTASTIC product that absorbs into my skin and gives it a glow. If you use a lot of it or have a darker skin tone it will, indeed, leave a slight white cast, especially around the eyebrows and at the hairline. But I find when I use too much and this happens I can rub it in more and it goes away. I also read a tip to mix mineral sunscreens with a few drops of your liquid foundation or a liquid bronzer to avoid the white cast effect. I even use it around my eyes with no stinging or irritation. It is very moisturizing. I love that it is a mineral sunscreen with other beneficial products and my skin definitely has improved in tone and clarity since I began using it. Highly recommend and hope they keep making this product!

I am very picky when it comes to sunscreen on my face. I have found very few that I like this one does not burn your eyes. That is an issue that I have found with a lot of facial sunscreens. They either burn your eyes or they’re very white the lotion is an earthy neutral color maybe a very light brown in color this is a especially helpful when you don’t have very light skin cause some sunscreen can make your skin look lighter and give it a white cast. I am older and have dry skin so I kinda wish that it was a little bit more hydrating, however I don’t think it was geared for older or dryer, skins, but for sunscreen it’s excellent. I am a glow girl, so I like the fact that it gives some glow to the skin is a winner for me. I would probably repurchase, but I wanted to buy a small one just to be sure I liked it. You really need a sunscreen if you use retinol and alpha hydroxy and BHA.

I have been using this product for years and I think it’s about time that I wrote a review. I am 34 and I have a super dry, very sensitive, blemish prone skin. I have tried so many products to find what actually works and this one is my all time favorite spf moisturizer. It gives my skin a lovely, natural glow while hydrating and protecting from the sun. Most glow sunscreen has a tint that looks unnatural and clogs pores. This one is different. Some days I don’t even feel like putting on makeup because it looks that good. Many times people complimented my skin when I only had this product on. Recently, my brother used it and also loved so I got one for him too. I highly recommend it!!

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin, this is for you!
avis.texte: This is soooo pricey but honestly so worth it. I have the worlds most sensitive skin (okay maybe not literally but seriously I have very sensitive/red skin) I’m Irish and pretty pale. I have extremely dry skin. I get red just from existing. This doesn’t make me red, doesn’t burn, doesn’t irritate my skin, AND it gives me an amazing glow. 10/10 recommend. Just try it, you won’t be disappointed! Ps. I little goes a long way so the larger bottle actually has lasted me a while
Previously was using vanicream facial spf. But it was out of stock for a little while. It feels like the same consistency which I love! Lightweight, no white cast and no strong smell. Lovely product!

I have purchased other Paula’s Choice products (a sleep mask and an exfoliating liquid) and loved them! This product however was terrible!! The color is gray, not white, which I honestly did not notice was wrong until I read other peoples reviews. It is extremely thick and does not blend in well AT ALL. Due to being so thick, the product makes my face look greasy af (I don’t ever have greasy skin) and has caused me to begin breaking out with acne again! $12 is steep for how tiny the bottle is. Not reading the size description was on me, but I still think it’s Spendy for what you get. I will stick with my $8 full size Walmart brand spf moisturizers! I do not recommend!

Use to love this but 40 dollars a tube and discontinuing products people love on top of it all? Come on. This is price gouging and I think this company has lost the plot. There are so many mineral sunscreen for half the cost or less now. Disappointing.

It has some tune to it by the way, a little tint, it's definitely a skin glowing moisturizer, feels a bit weird after 1 min of application but looks great under any tint or bb cream. i gave 5 stars because of the promised nice glow and being sensitive skin friendly.

I am sucker of mineral sunscreen, call it moisturizer with SPF or call it SpF with moisturizer, whatever you name it does the job beautifully Certainly will stay my forever best lightweight SPF , like usual I have stocked this up like other Paula’s choice products I use ( it’s pandemic & out of stock is not happy feeling 😬) , this spf beautifully suits normal to dry skin and like the name suggest Defence glow, it literally adds glow which is quite visible and I totally love it ♥️ Application: I apply two thin layer and it perfectly saves my skin from Sun damages and also soothes irritated skin if any ! Ps : it’s only SPF 30 so it’s perfect for indoor , I wear sunscreen daily & as it’s mineral sunscreen one can safely apply around the eye & on top of lips .. it never stings or irritate skin However if stepping outdoor and staying longer under the sun then apply a spf 50 preferably mineral 🙌🏻
Received product well but expiring in 2/2024 when I received in Nov 2023.

avis.titre: Quality moisture size moisturizing absorption texture fair skin sensitive
avis.texte: Love love love You have calm my nerves of getting older 47 yrs *feel clean / light *look disappearing *price I tried the trial size This did not break me out or bother me in any capacity the color did not stay white I am fair skin so it was perfect it goes on light then melted in I was able to put on primer /makeup no bad reaction to makeup Paula’s choice genius how they put intentional ingredients together exact what you need and helps the ingredients to work together Figure out your skin before trying products then you will buy exactly what you’re skin craves and needs Two kinds of sensitivity research which one you are * sensitivity issues like eczema et cetra * sensitivity to ingredients I’m the second one If you are too this is perfect check out the other ones I bought at same time the toner OMG try it If they keep the price and product level I’m a lifer:))

It’s a bit pricey but I love this sunscreen. It leaves a glowy look and isn’t too thick. It doesn’t leave a cast and isn’t oily either. I think it’s the best sunscreen out there. One star off because of the price tho but it’s worth it so.. idk

The product itself I'm happy with. It's lightweight, absorbs, protective, light pleasant scent, doesn't break me out, etc. But, I had a huge problem opening this package and finding out how small this bottle was. Granted, I did look at other .5fl oz. containers I had around the house to compare size for $12, but I will admit I was still pretty shocked how small it was and how much product is actually in the tube. Additionally, I wanted to try the smaller bottle to make sure it's a product that would work well for me. But, it's hard to get past paying this much money when there are certainly comparable brands/products. :( I'll enjoy the product while it last. But, I ultimately went with another option in the long term. :)

I’ve been a fan of the Paula’s Choice moisturizers for a long time now, but this is the first time I’ve purchased this one. I’ve now gone through about half the bottle and I’m in love. I use this in the morning and it provides ample moisture to my dry sensitive skin, but it still absorbs so I can apply makeup (a CC cream and powder blush) with no issues. If anything, I think it makes my makeup look better! It does have a very notable glow upon application, but I don’t mind. If the glow bothers you, it does disparate in under an hour. My boyfriend also uses this sometimes and he doesn’t mind once the glow wears off. My skin is very sensitive and I have psoriasis, this sunscreen moisturizer does not irritate me at all. I wouldn’t recommend using this as a primary sunscreen if you’re on vacation or something like that; you should use a separate SPF and reapply every 90 minutes or so to make sure your skin is protected.

avis.titre: Perfect no frills moisturizer with SPF30
avis.texte: Bought this last minute to have a good moisturizer with SPF for travel. This 2oz tube was perfect for my needs. I don’t know how I didn’t know about this brand earlier, but it’s a great thing to have. Smooth and easy on my face, no smell, non greasy and absorbed quickly. A little bit goes a long way too! Provides a gentle glow, very smooth. Moisturizers tend to make my skin look greasy and this one did none of that. Very easy under my makeup-would recommend.

Ordered this yesterday, received today, and it is a nearly empty tube in a nasty, dirty box covered with multiple return stickers, including Kohls. Looks like it was kicked around in the dirt. I'll return it too, so one of you will probably receive this nastiness next.

I enjoy this lotion because it doesn't have all the harsh chemicals most face sun screens have. It's not greasy or heavy at all. It feels good on my skin and keeps it hydrated and protected from the elements.

The fluid ounces is listed in the description so no one should really be surprised but I took these pictures to help drive the point home in regards to size. Will update on product quality. It has a slight tint to it, and as far as the quality, I just do not believe it is worth the price. I've experienced better results from less expensive products.

Like other comments have mentioned, the product i received isn’t white in color. It’s an odd shade of tan/gray. The first thing I noticed when I put it on my face was that it’s impossible to blend in and gives an awful gray cast on my skin. I’m the palest of pale, so I’d imagine anyone darker than me would see this issue as well. Next I noticed the burning. Not extreme but an uncomfortable tingle. After a little bit it was still pilling and burning so I washed my face. I thought that’s where this would end. But nope. When I worked out this evening, the sweat reactivated something from the product and left my face burning and puffy. Don’t recommend this product.
So far I’ve been using this product and it works well. Doesn’t leave my skin too oily and feels great. Only issue I have is paying $12 for what basically amounts to a sample size.
Looking for a new moisturizer decided to get the sample of this product. Most products don’t expire 3 months after you get it not happy about that!

I really like Paula’s Choice products. However, this is super tiny and too expensive for what I got. $13 for .5 oz. I can’t imagine paying $35 for 2 oz for $35!!!??? Nope. Yea, that is a quarter next to the “travel” size.

Just a little disappointing that the product came so dirty, and after application the product burns my face. I’m not sure if the formula was changed since I last used it(which was recently), but when I order directly from Paula’s choice I’ve never had these issues… lesson for sure learned
Know what you are buying! I paid $12 for this. Such a disappointment. I love Paula’s Choice products, so I am hoping a little bit goes a long way. I do however, feel robbed by the size of this thing.

Tube came with strange sticker on it to modify the label. Product is a tan/grey color and has been described elsewhere as white. The cream on the products description page is white. Not sure if this is a manufacturing whoops or genuine product. Either way, not spending that kind of money on it. Super annoyed that I have to send it back.

This went on nicely but after wearing it for a few hours my skin started to feel very dry. By the end of the day my whole face was red and hot to the touch. I don't know why it irritated my skin so much but I'll never put in on again.
